description: This file is a CMake module script designed to locate and configure the Broadcom Nexus library within a build system. It searches for Nexus related headers and libraries, sets up imported targets, and manages their configuration based on the system environment, supporting different modes like proxy and client modes.

methods.name: find_path
methods.description: Searches for the specified header file within the include paths.

methods.name: find_library
methods.description: Locates the specified library file in the system.

methods.name: include
methods.description: Includes additional CMake modules or scripts.

methods.name: find_package_handle_standard_args
methods.description: Handles standard validation of the found package components.

methods.name: add_library
methods.description: Creates an imported or static library target within CMake.

methods.name: set_target_properties
methods.description: Sets properties for CMake targets, such as IMPORTED_LOCATION, INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES, etc.

methods.name: message
methods.description: Outputs messages during CMake configuration process.
